title: Cancellation Lead Scale on Pre-Supply C&I Damages
content:
**Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts - termination before supply: cancellation lead.**

The damages of a termination before supply are scaled by its cancellation lead, the calendar days from the contract signed date to the termination notice date: 14 days or fewer scale them by 0.50, more than 14 up to 45 days scale them by 0.75, and a longer lead leaves them unscaled. The scale multiplies the damages kWh times the structure's rate, before that amount is rounded to the cent and compared with the minimum fee.

The days are counted from the contract signed date to the termination notice date, the signing day not counted.

| Cancellation lead | Damages multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 14 days or fewer | 0.50 |
| 15 to 45 days | 0.75 |
| 46 days or more | 1, unscaled |

## Boundary days

| Lead | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 14 | 0.50 |
| 15 | 0.75 |
| 45 | 0.75 |
| 46 | 1 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Damages kWh of 600002 at $0.0050 per kWh are 3000.01 before scaling; a contract signed on 1 June 2026 with a termination notice dated 1 July 2026 (30 days) takes 3000.01 multiplied by 0.75, that is 2250.0075, which on this scale alone rounds to $2250.01.
